title: Decide PromptHub to Rusty IDD front-door boundary

checkpoint.note: Deep local research found prompt_hub is a front-door/spec-producer surface with core library, CLI, server, prompt templates, swarm handoff, RBAC, audit, and vibe intent flow. Rusty IDD should consume goal artifacts rather than being embedded in prompt_hub. OpenSpec, ADR, AI_MERGE evidence, generated artifacts, and validation are complete.

completion.result: Decision recorded: Rusty IDD consumes PromptHub-produced goal artifacts through goal-file planning; PromptHub does not own Rusty IDD lifecycle internals.

intent_lock.goal: Decide whether Rusty IDD should consume prompt_hub or prompt_hub should consume Rusty IDD.
